messages.subject: Sutherland — IBR received; conditions precedent
messages.plaintextBody:
Lesley, Sarah,

We have received Marlow's independent business review and our credit team is reviewing it. On a first pass it supports the restructuring case — the estimated outcome statement is helpful. We will want the final IBR and the rolling 13-week cashflow as conditions precedent, plus the confirmatory security and the usual corporate CPs.

Can WC circulate a CP checklist?

Gavin Ross
Director, Restructuring & Recoveries | Sterling Commercial Bank plc
